uploadChooser.title: Upload files
uploadChooser.description: Choose any file type, not just photos or videos. Multiple files are supported.
uploadChooser.systemHint: If your phone shows Camera / Camcorder / Photos and videos, choose Photos and videos, then look for Browse, Files or file locations in the side menu. Labels depend on your phone and browser.

start.title: New session
start.description: Resume a suspended session or choose a connection to open a terminal.

terminal.ownershipUnknown: Connection ownership is unknown; automatic retries stopped. Close this tab before opening a new connection. The original remote process may still be running.
terminal.confirmReset: Reset the terminal for “{name}”? This closes the current SSH session and opens a new terminal, clearing its screen and command draft. Transfers and unsaved edits may be affected. Background processes may continue running.
terminal.resetUnavailable: Only connected terminals without a suspend mark can be reset. Unmark suspended sessions first.
terminal.resetCloseUnconfirmed: The old session could not be confirmed closed. Reset stopped without opening a new session. Check remote tasks before closing this tab.
terminal.resetFailed: Terminal reset failed. Check the session and remote task status.

errors.suspendedConnectionNotSsh: The suspended session no longer points to an SSH connection.

layout.conflict: The workspace layout or pane sizes changed. This adjustment was not saved. Refresh the layout before adjusting it again.
layout.unknown: The layout save could not be confirmed. Refresh and verify it first; the save will not be repeated automatically.
layout.failed: The workspace layout could not be read or saved. Refresh it and try again.

connectionFailure.network: Connection to Nexus was interrupted. Check your network and retry.
connectionFailure.timeout: The connection timed out. Please retry shortly.
connectionFailure.unexpected: Unable to connect right now. Retry, or check the service logs if this continues.
connectionFailure.remote_unavailable: Unable to establish SSH. Check the server address, port, credentials and SSH service.
connectionFailure.host_key_untrusted: The server identity has not been confirmed. Reconnect to review and confirm its fingerprint.
connectionFailure.unauthenticated: Your login has expired. Sign in again before connecting.
connectionFailure.forbidden: Access was denied. Check your account permissions and access policy.
connectionFailure.not_found: The connection or original session no longer exists. Open it again from Connections.
connectionFailure.conflict: The session state has changed. Retry shortly, or check the suspended sessions list.
connectionFailure.stale_target: The connection settings have changed. Open it again from Connections.
connectionFailure.limit_exceeded: Resources are busy. Retry shortly or close unused sessions.
connectionFailure.operation_unknown: The connection result is unconfirmed. Check the session before creating another.
connectionFailure.invalid_input: The connection settings are invalid. Check them in Connections and retry.
connectionFailure.command_failed: The remote terminal could not start. Check the server shell configuration.
connectionFailure.not_text: The server returned an unusable connection response. Check its configuration.
connectionFailure.suspendedRefresh: Unable to read suspended sessions. Check your network and retry.
connectionFailure.suspendedMissing: This suspended session is no longer listed. Open the suspended sessions list to check.

layoutConfigurator.title: Layout Configurator
layoutConfigurator.noAvailablePanes: All panes are already in the layout
layoutConfigurator.emptyLayout: Layout is empty. Drag panes from the left or add a container.
layoutConfigurator.dropHere: Drop panes from available list here
layoutConfigurator.saveError: Error saving layout. Please try again later.
layoutConfigurator.confirmClearLayout: Are you sure you want to clear the entire layout? All panes will return to the available list.
layoutConfigurator.lockUpdateError: Failed to update layout lock status.
layoutConfigurator.confirmClose: You have unsaved changes. Are you sure you want to close?
layoutConfigurator.confirmReset: Restore the default layout and sidebar configuration? Current changes will be lost.

noActiveSession.title: No Active Session
noActiveSession.message: Please connect to a session first
noActiveSession.fileManagerSidebar: File Manager requires an active session
noActiveSession.statusMonitorSidebar: Status Monitor requires an active session
